basis_reconciliation_doc: flat_to_flat_pnl_total and fifo_pnl_total_via_flat_to_flat_rows must be equal (within float rounding) -- both sum the SAME underlying fills, just grouped differently (position-cycle vs FIFO-matched-chunk). fifo_trip_count_total >= n_rows always (a flat_to_flat row is >=1 FIFO legs, never fewer).
